main_text.head: ΕΙΔΟΣ I.
Agesidamo Locro Epizephyrio iuueni pugili 10.
Argumentum.
main_text.p: AGesidamo Locro, qui Olympicis ludis vicerat cestibus Olympiade 74. promiserat poeta carmen victoriale, non præstitit autem statim. itaque eius culpam hic in obliuionem reiicit: promittit tamen non solum debitum carmen: verum etiam intermissionis nomine τόκον[?] vsuram: Inde laudes Agesidemi ingreditur commedans eum a patria, causis adiuuatibus, vt est Ilas aliptes eius, labores, quibus ad victoriam peruenit. Hinc digressio fit in historiam de bello Herculis & Augiæ, quo trucidato instituit ludos Olympicos, & quæ ad eos pertinebât. victores etiam primos in his certaminibus ab Hercule coronatos percurrit. Redit postea ad rem ceptam carminis victorialis dignitatem extollens, & Epilogo, non sine præconio laudum moriturum Agesidemum concludens.

The Greek line beginning Αἰάντειον is also uncertain in its accents. "commedans" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for "commendans". The printed numbers "10." and "74." and "12." are copied as printed. The ode title and the heading ΕΙΔΟΣ I. are read from the scan. The running head is "IN PINDARVM." and the page number is 157.
